shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
find .next/server/app -name "index.html" -o -name "index.prefetch.rsc" | head; echo "--- SHELL HTML ---"; cat .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' | head -c 1500

npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
echo "=== request A ==="
curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
echo "=== request B ==="
curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Grace; team=Infra' -H 'x-region: us-east' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
echo "=== request C (no cookies) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
git status --short && echo "--- tsconfig diff ---" && git diff tsconfig.json

npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
echo "=== request A (Ada/Platform/eu-west) ==="
curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [^"<\\]*|Team: [^"<\\]*|Region: [^"<\\]*|[0-9]+","? ?active projects|active projects'
echo "=== request B (Grace/Infra/us-east) ==="
curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Grace; team=Infra' -H 'x-region: us-east' http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [^"<\\]*|Team: [^"<\\]*|Region: [^"<\\]*'
echo "=== request C (no cookies/headers) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [^"<\\]*|Team: [^"<\\]*|Region: [^"<\\]*'
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "--- next-env diff ---"; git diff next-env.d.ts

npx next start -p 3125 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
for spec in "Ada:Platform:eu-west" "Grace:Infra:us-east"; do
  IFS=: read m t r <<< "$spec"
  echo "=== $m / $t / $r ==="
  curl -s -H "Cookie: member=$m; team=$t" -H "x-region: $r" http://localhost:3125/ > /tmp/resp.html
  for needle in "$m" "$t" "$r"; do
    if grep -q "$needle" /tmp/resp.html; then echo "  FOUND: $needle"; else echo "  MISSING: $needle"; fi
  done
done
echo "=== no cookies/headers (defaults) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3125/ > /tmp/resp0.html
for needle in Guest Community global; do
  if grep -q "$needle" /tmp/resp0.html; then echo "  FOUND: $needle"; else echo "  MISSING: $needle"; fi
done
echo "  leaked Ada? $(grep -c Ada /tmp/resp0.html)"
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true

rm -rf /workspace/.next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20 && echo "=== opt-out check ===" && grep -rn "force-dynamic\|force-static\|export const dynamic\|export const revalidate\|export const fetchCache\|connection()" /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/next.config.ts || echo "none found"
